Container.Name: seadex-scout
Container.Overview:
Report-only watcher flagging better SeaDex releases for a Sonarr/Radarr anime library.
Compares your Sonarr/Radarr anime library against SeaDex (the community-curated index of the best anime releases) and tells you, per title, when SeaDex recommends a better release than the one on disk. It never downloads or touches a torrent client: it writes a report and a warning log line, and you decide. Optionally serves the SeaDex picks as a Torznab feed for Sonarr, Radarr or Prowlarr.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: seadex anime sonarr radarr releases.moe torznab
Container.Requires:
Sonarr URL and Sonarr API key are enough to start. Fill them in and the first start writes /config/config.yaml, reads your values from these fields and begins comparing; leave Radarr empty if you only run Sonarr.
A finding is a warning line in the container log, never a download. Read the log from the Docker tab.
For a full season-by-season report, run this from an Unraid terminal (Tools, then Terminal) while the container is up: docker exec seadex-scout /seadex-scout report It writes a timestamped Markdown and JSON pair into /config/reports. The container is distroless, so the Console button in the Docker tab does not work.
Everything else is tuned in /config/config.yaml, which is annotated. The container reads it once at start, so restart it after an edit.
The Torznab port is only bound when a Torznab URL is set in config.yaml; leave the port mapping alone otherwise. Keep that feed on your LAN: its AnimeBytes links carry your passkey.

Config.Name: Sonarr URL
Config.Description: Where seadex-scout reaches Sonarr, including scheme and port, e.g. http://192.0.2.100:8989 (use the server's LAN IP, not a container name)

Config.Name: Sonarr API key
Config.Description: Sonarr's API key, from Sonarr: Settings, General, API Key

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: config.yaml, state and the reports folder

Config.Name: Radarr URL
Config.Description: Where seadex-scout reaches Radarr, e.g. http://192.0.2.100:7878; leave empty to watch Sonarr only

Config.Name: Radarr API key
Config.Description: Radarr's API key, from Radarr: Settings, General, API Key; required when Radarr URL is set

Config.Name: Torznab port
Config.Description: Torznab feed for Sonarr, Radarr or Prowlarr; only listens when a Torznab URL is configured in config.yaml
